hooks.command:
set -- `# <#`
bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.sh" start
exit
: <<'#PS_END'
#>
$u = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [Console]::InputEncoding = $u; [Console]::OutputEncoding = $u; $OutputEncoding = $u
$in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -eq 'Core') { $in | pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.ps1" start } else { $in | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.ps1" start }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
#PS_END
